description: This file defines functions and types for analyzing and collecting command secret assignments from configuration snapshots in an OpenClaw project, including handling unresolved and inactive secrets.

methods.name: analyzeCommandSecretAssignmentsFromSnapshot
methods.description: Analyzes secret assignments from a configuration snapshot, returning assignments, diagnostics, unresolved, and inactive secrets.

methods.name: collectCommandSecretAssignmentsFromSnapshot
methods.description: Collects secret assignments from a snapshot, throwing an error if unresolved secrets are found.
